veranderings.blok: Die howe hou wag oor die Grondwet
veranderings.rede: The sentence just before names a landdroshof, so 'daardie howe' makes the reader look back past it; naming the higher courts again makes the reference immediate without changing the meaning.
The previous item says the power is 'beperk' but never uses the noun 'grense', so the demonstrative 'daardie' points back to a word that is not there; 'die grense' reads naturally.
